Their blog covers a variety of topics, including leather care, fashion trends, and product reviews. The brand's mission is to provide customers with high-quality leather belts that are both timeless and fashionable.

feeds.title: Obscure Belts Blog
feeds.description: Obscure Belts Blog is a blog dedicated to exploring the world of unique and unusual belts. Their mission is to showcase the creativity and craftsmanship of small, independent belt makers from around the world. The blog features interviews with these makers and highlights their unique designs and techniques.

feeds.title: BestLeather.org
feeds.description: This blog focuses on high-quality leather belts and related accessories, featuring reviews and buying guides for both men and women. Founded in 2011, the mission of BestLeather.org is to help consumers make informed purchasing decisions by providing detailed product information and expert insights.

feeds.title: Roger Ximenez Blog
